title: incremental-model-gating-with-explainable-rollbacks
author: Maya Gupta
commits: Introduce GatingController scaffolding and decision API
Add rollback ledger: immutable event log + explainability pointers
Integrate gating with traffic router and shadow dispatcher
Add integration tests for incremental gate thresholds and automated rollback
Fix: race in KV cache snapshot during promote path
description:
Motivation: We need a lightweight, auditable gating primitive that lets teams perform incremental canaries and A/B promotions with deterministic, explainable rollback decisions. Current staged-rollout controllers focus on traffic fraction but surface little rationale for why a rollback happened (metric deltas, telemetry anchors), which makes post-mortem and compliance harder. This PR introduces an incremental model gating controller and a companion immutable rollback ledger that records the decision context used by automated rollback heuristics.

What this PR does: Implements a new GatingController that: 1) accepts declarative gate policies (metric anchors, acceptable delta ranges, latency/quality tradeoffs), 2) performs incremental increases in traffic with configurable holdpoints, 3) evaluates multi-metric gates using weighted voting and a temporal smoothing window, and 4) emits an explainable rollback recommendation when thresholds are breached. The RollbackLedger persists concise decision snapshots (hashable) including metric snapshots, the active policy, recent commits, and the reconciliation trace that led to the recommendation. The console gets a small inspector panel that renders the ledger entry for the active rollouts so SREs and PMs can inspect 'why' a rollback executed.

Design notes: - Decision model is deterministic: identical inputs reproduce the same recommendation (helps offline replay and audits). - Ledger entries are append-only and reference the deploy bundle id and model snapshot id; sensitive fields are redacted by default and available via KMS-backed unwrap for enterprise customers. - Automated rollback uses a two-stage flow: soft-quarantine (traffic hold + increased sampling) followed by hard rollback. Soft-quarantine gives the system a chance to collect focused telemetry before committing to a revert. - For A/B tests, the same gating primitives can enforce minimum cohort sizes and require cross-cohort significance tests before promote.

Testing: Added unit and integration tests that simulate a high-noise latency spike and a small-quality regression. Tests verify: gate triggers when weighted metric score crosses threshold, ledger entries contain the right context, soft-quarantine increases sample rate and delays immediate rollback, and console inspector renders a minimal explainable narrative. Also added a deterministic offline replay test that loads a ledger entry and verifies the decision path is recreated exactly.

Backward compatibility & rollout: GatingController is opt-in via rollout.spec.gating; existing rollout controllers are unchanged. Behavior toggles are behind a feature flag (feature.rollout_gating) and the ledger storage defaults to local append log; enterprise installs can switch to S3-backed ledger with KMS encryption.

Operational concerns & mitigations: - Performance: decision evaluation is O(N_metrics) per holdpoint; we batch metric fetches and reuse cached windows to keep added CPU negligible. Benchmarks included in the PR show <2% median runtime increase for a 1000-rps controller instance. - Safety: soft-quarantine reduces the chance of noisy immediate reverts; we also set a minimum time window before a hard rollback. - Security: ledger entries are redactable and access-controlled; we added RBAC checks in console inspector.

Release notes: Adds an opt-in GatingController for incremental canaries and an auditable RollbackLedger to produce explainable rollback decisions. Console includes an inspector for ledger entries.

Related work: similar to deferred-shadow-buffer approach but optimized for explainability and auditability rather than replay fidelity (see ENG-2099). Also referenced SUP-4121 for a customer incident where unexplained rollbacks caused operational issues.

Merge summary: CI passed after two fixups (race condition in KV snapshot, and edge case in A/B cohort size check). Reviewers approved: Diego Ramos (safety review), Anya Petrov (telemetry), Liam Chen (runtime). Merged via squash into main on 2026-02-24.
review_threads:
Diego Ramos: Safety: ensure soft-quarantine doesn't leave traffic stuck — request configurable quarantine timeout.
Maya: Added timeout with sensible default and override in policy; added test.

Anya Petrov: Telemetry: need additional histogram for scaled-weighted-score to catch boundary flapping.
Maya: Added histogram 'rollout.gate.weighted_score' and hooked it into the metrics exporter.

Liam Chen: Runtime: observed a data race in promote path during local tests.
Maya: Fixed by snapshotting KV cache reference and added integration test that repros the race, CI green after fix.
release_notes: Opt-in GatingController for staged canaries + RollbackLedger for auditable/explainable rollback decisions. Console inspector for ledger entries. Configurable soft-quarantine behavior and enterprise ledger storage options.
